trap-superlative.evidence: Three findings, two of them checkable errors. (1) PIN CURRENCY: the block prints "q_0 = 1.109978595554181... (muon pin, 16 dps)". That is the OLD muon value - the current muon pin is 1.10997859555733471, and the two diverge at the 13th significant figure. The old value is arithmetically correct rather than corrupt, so this is a currency defect; and per the 2026-08-07 owner directive the default for compute is now the proton pin 1.1099785827513808. Separately, the AGENTS notation register forbids a specific numerical q_0 outside the introduction and Chapter 7, and this is a mass-theory remark. (2) NOT DIMENSIONLESS: "dimensionless ratios such as m_mu/m_e and m_n - m_p" - a mass difference is not a ratio and is not dimensionless; it is exactly the kind of quantity whose value depends on the anchor the sentence claims it is independent of. (3) "m_e is the most precisely measured particle mass in the Standard Model" is an unsourced superlative. VERIFIED CORRECT: m_e(natural) = Li_2(q^-2)/hbar_q^2 computes to 111.8955 at the proton pin and 111.8955 at the muon pin, matching the "approximately 112" recorded in observations/epistemic-status-of-calibrations.md; [N]_q as written is the standard quantum integer; the anchor values 0.511 MeV, 246 GeV and 1.22e19 GeV are right; and CAL-1 = m_e agrees with the AGENTS calibration doctrine.
trap-superlative.notes: Reported, not edited. Route: re-pin the quoted q_0 to the proton value or drop the numeral entirely per the notation register; replace "m_n - m_p" with an actual dimensionless quantity (m_n/m_p) or move it to a separate clause about splittings; source or soften the precision claim. NOTE also: "m(K) = Vol(K) * rho_q with rho_q = 1/hbar_q^2" drops the per-block density rho(K) from the AGENTS canonical shape m(K) = m_e * Vol(K) * rho(K) / hbar_q^2 - possibly a different (Kashaev) convention, worth confirming against rem:kashaev-volume-density.
